1. Pouring Whiskey & Pondering: Pours amber whiskey into a tumbler while staring pensively through the blinds at the rainy street below
2. Unfolding the Blackmail Letter: Unfolds a crumpled telegram on the wooden desk, scanning the typed words with rising suspicion

4. Confrontation at the Desk: Stands face-to-face across the desk, leaning forward into the warm lamplight with an uncompromising stare
5. Lighting a Match in the Dark: Strikes a match against the matchbook, the golden flame briefly illuminating the tense expression
